sloka: तैस्तैरनिष्टोपगमैरजस्रं यत्र कुत्र कः ।मतिमान्मानुषे लोके युद्धेन प्रणयी भवेत् ।। ७.२०.१० ॥
transliteration: taistairaniṣṭopagamairajasraṁ yatra kutra kaḥ ।matimānmānuṣe loke yuddhena praṇayī bhavet ।। 7.20.10 ॥

translations.english: Who would kill such people who are constantly bewildered about their welfare, surrounded by great misfortunes, and afflicted by hundreds of old age and diseases?
